summary: 22-year-old man critically injured after falling off a boat on Horsetooth Reservoir and being run over by its intoxicated driver; serious propeller lacerations to his right side; flown by AirLink to Medical Center of the Rockies in critical condition.
notes: The Coloradoan, Jun. 30, 2013 (Sarah Jane Kyle); boat carried ~9 people, many underage and severely intoxicated per LCSO; responders LCSO + county parks + Poudre Fire Authority + AirLink + Poudre Valley Hospital ambulance; identities withheld; investigation ongoing whether the fall was accidental/alcohol-related or intentional.
